description: Nasdaq cross order-entry cutoffs (v1.13, X-P1-5), as seconds BEFORE the cross. A market-on-close / on-open order (the AUC01 exit="cross" leg) is only accepted while time_to_cross_s > cutoff_s. Rows are dated: the row with the latest valid_from <= the session date applies. iap.auction.strategy.DEFAULT_ENTRY_CUTOFFS mirrors this file (a test pins the two equal).

cutoffs.source: Pre-October-2018 rule: MOC/LOC cutoff and NOII start 3:50 p.m. ET, as described in SEC Release 34-85292 (https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2019/34-85292.pdf)

SEC Release 34-85292 (https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2019/34-85292.pdf): in October 2018 Nasdaq moved the Closing Cross cutoff (MOC entry) and NOII start to 3:55 p.m. ET; Nasdaq Closing Cross FAQ (https://www.nasdaqtrader.com/content/productsservices/Trading/ClosingCrossfaq.pdf): MOC accepted until 3:55 p.m. ET
Nasdaq Opening/Closing Cross quick guide (https://www.nasdaqtrader.com/content/technicalsupport/specifications/TradingProducts/openclosequickguide.pdf): MOO/LOO orders accepted until 9:28 a.m. ET
